title: The Allex
description: Streamlining POS order processing, reducing staff onboarding time, and accelerating merchant setup.

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: Connecting daily transaction speed with staff retention
body: Hospitality operators faced high turnover and slow order processing due to complex legacy POS software. As founding designer, I designed the mobile POS app and merchant website builder from scratch to increase order throughput and simplify staff onboarding.

sections.label: Process
sections.heading: Designing for high-pressure restaurant floors
body: On-site observations showed servers losing time navigating deep menu hierarchies during peak hours. I replaced multi-tap flows with a high-contrast, task-focused interface and added real-time performance milestones to motivate staff.
bullets: Replaced multi-step menu navigation with direct single-tap ordering.
Introduced staff performance milestones to boost retention and team morale.
Built a unified brand identity across POS software and the merchant site builder.

sections.label: Result
sections.heading: Faster table turns and 5-minute merchant setup
body: Shipped a dual-product platform: a mobile POS that cut average order processing time by 35%, and a template-driven site builder enabling small businesses to launch online ordering in minutes.
bullets: Mobile POS app optimized for single-hand operation on active restaurant floors.
Admin dashboard consolidating sales metrics, staff shifts, and inventory.
No-code site builder with ready-to-use templates for local businesses.

sections.label: Reflection
sections.heading: Systematic design accelerates product expansion
body: Establishing a parent design system early allowed us to launch two distinct products with half the design overhead. Consistent component tokens kept development velocity high as the platform expanded.
